_comment: Phase-8 example: a PyTorch CNN with padded AveragePool and GlobalAveragePool, trained on real 8x8 handwritten digits (sklearn load_digits), exported to digit_gap_cnn.onnx, loaded through the ONNX front door (penumbra.load_onnx) and quantized via penumbra.Model.quantize. The serialized IR graph is under 'graph'; the 10 logits are the graph output. FHE output must equal these quantized-cleartext logits/labels bit-for-bit.
